final_message:
I changed the event so that both ARCH-4 failures should clear. I haven't run CI or the tests, because shell commands are denied in this session.

`OrderPlaced` now carries `createdAt` and `amountCents`, and it also keeps `placedAt` and `totalCents` as `@deprecated` aliases with the same values. `analytics-ingest` and `billing-service` still find the fields they require. The changes are in `src/core/events.ts` and the deepEqual in `test/app.test.ts`.

This isn't a complete rename. The old names stay in the event until both consumers move to the new ones. Once they have, delete the two alias fields and the matching lines in the test.

Please run `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` in `orders-service`, then re-run CI.
